Keep your cards close.\nYour story closer.
A game of brave claims, raised eyebrows, and one last light.
Everyone gets five hidden cards. Each round asks for Crown, Moon, or Star. Wild cards always match.
On your turn, play one to three cards face down. You claim they all match the table. They don’t have to.
Play to accept the last claim, or challenge it. One wrong card catches the bluff. If every card matches, the challenger loses.
The loser advances a six-light fuse. Its hidden burnout point is fixed for the match. A safe light keeps you in; burnout means you spectate.
Every challenge ends the round. The host deals again to the survivors. The last player still in wins.
An empty hand isn’t a free pass.
Your final cards can still be challenged. Once accepted, you sit out until the next round. The last player holding cards must challenge.
The lights are a fictional game mechanic. No wagers, weapons, or real-world penalties.
